How the 1,000 homes were selected

Source

The March 6, 2026 Miami file in the public resi-dataset archive preserves records from Zillow.

Selection

The first 1,000 eligible houses had a for-sale status, positive USD asking price and a Zillow URL. Street addresses had to be disclosed and free of explicit unit labels.

Verification

Every Zillow ID and street-address/ZIP pair is unique. Two Zillow pages were spot-checked. Current availability across all 1,000 is unknown.

Source and coverage

The archive includes the first 1,000 distinct eligible houses in source order, using each listing’s Miami mailing address. Asking prices and statuses reflect the March 2026 capture.
